user.title: Set up TV-Zapper
user.description: Address of the TV (network ADB must be enabled on the TV). On the first connection the TV asks “Allow USB debugging?” – choose “Always allow” with the remote and press OK (you have 60 seconds). {fehler}

data.favorit: Name of the channel list in the programme guide

reconfigure.title: TV-Zapper: change address
reconfigure.description: New address or ADB port of the TV. Your settings are kept. {fehler}

error.cannot_connect: No ADB connection to the TV. Is it on, is network ADB enabled and was the prompt on the TV confirmed?
error.host_ungueltig: Invalid address: IP address or host name, only letters, digits, dot, colon and hyphen.
error.favorit_ungueltig: Name of the channel list is missing or too long (60 characters at most).

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

init.title: TV-Zapper: settings
init.description: Interests: one line per category, `Name | Weight | word, word*, …`. A `*` at the end of a word matches the start of a word (doku* = Doku, Dokumentation). Each category counts its weight once, the sum decides. {fehler}

data.verweilen_min: Time per channel (minutes between two checks)
data.favorit: Name of the channel list in the programme guide
data.sender_nie: Never pick these channels (names as in the programme guide, separated by commas)
data.sender_bevorzugt: Preferred channels: one line per channel, `Channel name | bonus points` (only counts if the show matches too)
data.einblendung: On-screen message on the TV (when switching on, switching channel and at the end)
data.protokoll: TV log: check regularly what is on (sensor “Läuft jetzt”, also without the zapper)
data.takt_s: Polling interval of the TV log in seconds (how often “Läuft jetzt” asks)
data.speicher_min: Read the memory of the TV and the TV app every … minutes (0 = off)
data.mac: MAC address of the TV for Wake-on-LAN (empty = do not wake, e.g. aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff)

error.interessen_ungueltig: Interests contain an error – see the note above.
error.bonus_ungueltig: Preferred channels contain an error – see the note above.
error.mac_ungueltig: MAC address contains an error – see the note above.
error.woerter_ungueltig: List contains an error – see the note above.
error.favorit_ungueltig: Name of the channel list is missing or too long (60 characters at most).
